info.title: OMA LwM2M Roll over sensor (Object ID 3451)

Roll_over_sensor.label: Roll over sensor
Roll_over_sensor.description: The uCIFI Roll Over Sensor is used to measure the roll component of displacement and can be useful in safety application, by complementing the existing IPSO Direction and uCIFI Tilt sensors.

Angle.label: Angle
Angle.description: Angle of inclination between the internal horizontal line and the parallel to earth

Minimum_measured_Angle.label: Minimum measured Angle
Minimum_measured_Angle.description: Minimum angle measured by the roll over sensor since last reset or since power ON if no reset

Maximum_measured_angle.label: Maximum measured angle
Maximum_measured_angle.description: Maximum angle measured by the roll over sensor since last reset or since power ON if no reset

Out_of_position_threshold.label: Out of position threshold
Out_of_position_threshold.description: The angle above which the device triggers an out of position event

Out_of_position.label: Out of position
Out_of_position.description: Set to True if the angle is above the out of position threshold

Timestamp.label: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the measurement was performed.

Fractional_Timestamp.label: Fractional Timestamp
Fractional_Timestamp.description: Fractional part of the timestamp when sub-second precision is used (e.g., 0.23 for 230 ms).

Reset_min_max_angles.label: Reset min max angles
Reset_min_max_angles.description: Set the minimum and maximum measured angles to the current angle value
